Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + POC kickoff: Acme Corp

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for a great discovery call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before kickoff:  

Pain points you shared:
- Search/retrieval latency causing slow UX for customer support agents (esp. multi-doc queries).
- Cost per chat is spiking when agents hit long context windows; want predictable unit economics.
- Need stronger audit/logging for compliance and easy export for audits.

Goals for POC (30 days):
1) Demonstrate median response latency <= 300ms for single-shot agent queries at 50 qps.
2) Reduce per-session token cost by 25% vs current baseline using batching/caching/quantization.
3) Verify audit log export + access controls meet your security checklist items.

Proposed scope & owners:
- Scope: ingest first 10k support tickets, create a 150-prompt eval set, run three model/config variants (baseline, batching+cache, quantized).
- Redwood: Marissa (PD/AM) — overall POC lead; Aditya (Solutions Eng) — infra & integration; Rishi (SRE) — telemetry & SLOs.
- Acme: Alex (product), Security/Legal contact for compliance doc exchange.

Timeline (tentative):
- Week 0: Kickoff + access & GCP project shared (this week).
- Week 1: Data ingest & prompt set delivery (Acme provides sample tickets).
- Week 2: Run evals & iterate prompts.
- Week 3: Present results + recommendation; agree success criteria for expansion.

Access/setup steps we need from Acme this week:
- GCP project ID + IAM role for our service account (logs-only + object read for ingest).
- Sample CSV of 500 tickets for initial prompt set.
- Security point-of-contact and any required NDA/SoC2 paperwork.

Attached: initial POC scope doc (redwood-poc-scope.pdf) and SOC2 summary.

Next steps: can you confirm the GCP project and security contact so Aditya can request access? Also confirm the kickoff time for tomorrow at 10 AM PT if that still works.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Partner Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142
